def transform(grid):
    h,w=len(grid),len(grid[0])
    # The colored rectangle acts as a seed: extend its rows/columns across
    # the canvas, with each isolated marker indicating a line to extend.
    out=[row[:] for row in grid]
    cells=[(r,c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c]==2]
    if not cells: return out
    r0=min(r for r,c in cells); r1=max(r for r,c in cells)
    c0=min(c for r,c in cells); c1=max(c for r,c in cells)
    for r in range(h):
      for c in range(w):
        if r0<=r<=r1 and c0<=c<=c1: out[r][c]=2
    # Markers in rows intersecting the seed rectangle extend its color to full row;
    # markers in columns intersecting it extend full column.
    for r in range(h):
      if any(grid[r][c]==1 for c in range(w)) and r0<=r<=r1:
        out[r]=[2]*w
    for c in range(w):
      if any(grid[r][c]==1 for r in range(h)) and c0<=c<=c1:
        for r in range(h): out[r][c]=2
    return out
PY

def transform(grid):
    h,w=len(grid),len(grid[0]); out=[r[:] for r in grid]
    cells=[(r,c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c]==2]
    r0=min(r for r,c in cells); r1=max(r for r,c in cells)
    c0=min(c for r,c in cells); c1=max(c for r,c in cells)
    # Expand rows of the rectangle toward the side opposite an external marker.
    for r in range(r0,r1+1):
        left=any(grid[r][c] not in (0,2) for c in range(c0))
        right=any(grid[r][c] not in (0,2) for c in range(c1+1,w))
        if left and not right: start,end=c1+1,w
        elif right and not left: start,end=0,c0
        else: start,end=0,w
        for c in range(start,end):
            if grid[r][c]==0: out[r][c]=2
    # Extend rectangle columns above/below, excluding marked columns.
    for c in range(c0,c1+1):
        if not any(grid[r][c] not in (0,2) for r in range(r0)):
            for r in range(r0):

        if not any(grid[r][c] not in (0,2) for r in range(r1+1,h)):
            for r in range(r1+1,h):
                if grid[r][c]==0: out[r][c]=2

def transform(grid):
    h,w=len(grid),len(grid[0]); out=[row[:] for row in grid]
    cells=[(r,c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c]==2]
    r0=min(r for r,c in cells); r1=max(r for r,c in cells)
    c0=min(c for r,c in cells); c1=max(c for r,c in cells)
    marks=[(r,c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c] not in (0,2)]
    # Extend each object's row away from any side marker; without a marker,
    # extend in both directions.
    for r in range(r0,r1+1):
        left=any(rr==r and c<c0 for rr,c in marks)
        right=any(rr==r and c>c1 for rr,c in marks)
        cols=range(c0,w) if left and not right else range(c0+1) if right and not left else range(w)
        for c in cols:
            if grid[r][c]==0: out[r][c]=2
    # Project the object's columns above and below, omitting columns marked
    # on the corresponding side.
    for c in range(c0,c1+1):
        if not any(rr<r0 and cc==c for rr,cc in marks):
            for r in range(r0):
                if grid[r][c]==0: out[r][c]=2
        if not any(rr>r1 and cc==c for rr,cc in marks):
            for r in range(r1+1,h):
                if grid[r][c]==0: out[r][c]=2
    return out
